sql: WITH RankedPay AS (SELECT f.family_label, c.company_name, f.comp_mid_usd, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.family_label ORDER BY f.comp_mid_usd DESC) as rn FROM fct_posting f JOIN dim_company c ON f.company_key = c.company_key WHERE f.remote_us = TRUE AND f.is_open = TRUE AND f.comp_mid_usd IS NOT NULL) SELECT family_label, company_name, comp_mid_usd FROM RankedPay WHERE rn = 1
